name: riffkit
description: The official Riffkit plugin: make short vertical videos from Claude Code by remaking a winning short video with your own product, character and language.

plugins.name: riffkit
plugins.description: Remake a winning TikTok, Reel or Short into your own video (Adapt), keep a video's shots and change the person, product or style (Swap), or make one from a written idea. Product ads and UGC-style videos in 9 languages; the agent quotes the price before it spends credits.
